existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `BiologicallyDerivedProduct` has material local breaking changes despite unchanged resource identity. Top concerns are legacy field removals, `status` and `productCategory` representation changes, and non-lossless R6-to-R4 traceability/property content. The main uncertainty is the absence of official element-level migration maps and ballot rationale.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration is not a simple validator-version change. Implementers must transform primitive `code` fields to coded datatypes, rename/split fields, decide how to preserve removed processing/manipulation/storage/quantity details, and handle R6-only traceability fields through extensions or loss-aware downgrade rules.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural, cardinality, type, binding-strength, and local terminology differences because both StructureDefinitions and related local CodeSystems/ValueSets were inspected. Confidence is medium for intent and best mappings because official narrative diffs, ballot notes, terminology-server expansions, and element-level R4-to-R6 ConceptMaps were not available.

topFindings.title: R4 processing and manipulation backbones were removed from R6
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 processing/manipulation backbones are unknown in R6; R6-to-R4 and R4-to-R6 transforms can be lossy when product codes or properties cannot reconstruct event details.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R4 `storage` backbone was removed and partly replaced by `storageTempRequirements`
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `storage` content is invalid in R6; migration is lossy for duration, description, multiple storage entries, and possibly temperature-unit semantics.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `quantity` was removed with no direct R6 replacement
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances containing `quantity` are invalid in R6; migration may also be lossy because R6 has no stable core destination for the count.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `status` was replaced by `productStatus` with Coding and a different status code system
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `status` is an unknown path in R6 and its primitive code shape is not the R6 `Coding`; R6 lifecycle values also lose meaning on downgrade to R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `productCategory` changed from a single required-bound primitive code to repeating CodeableConcepts
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 primitive string values are not valid against the R6 CodeableConcept array shape; R6-to-R4 loss can occur for multiple categories or categories outside the R4 required set.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `collection.source` was split into `sourcePatient` and `sourceOrganization`
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `collection.source` is removed; there is also R6-to-R4 loss when R6 carries both patient and organization because R4 has only one source slot.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds traceability, facility, expiration, procedure, temperature, and generic property content not directly representable in R4
topFindings.affectedPath: BiologicallyDerivedProduct.therapyIdentifier / biologicalSourceEvent / processingFacility / division / expirationDate / collection.procedure / storageTempRequirements / property
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 instances using the new optional fields cannot be represented in R4 core without extensions, companion records, or data loss; there is no R4-to-R6 old-valid/new-invalid break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `productCode` kept its datatype but changed terminology guidance and semantics toward standardized product characterization
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation: terminology guidance and interpretation changed, but the element's path, datatype, cardinality, and permissive binding strength remain compatible.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
